fact: NIRA says it developed and integrated the NSIS national ID system with a birth and death registration module built on open source OpenCRVS, with automatic NIN issuance on birth notification and immediate certification, and lists deploying crvs.nsis.nira.go.ug for birth registration as a next step.
The World Bank's WDI lists Uganda's completeness of birth registration at 32.2% for 2016, a national rate not tied to a digital system.
